coordinateSystem: 1200 x 1600 upright working pixels, integer centers; transformed to full image with half-pixel resize convention
reviewMethod: Manual inspection of all seven whole images and native-resolution edge/gap crops. Background-only polygons; sampling mask only, no geometry removed.

instrumentSkyExclusion.reason: Native photo review identifies strongly blue sky inside instrument apertures; the inherited Vision mask closes some holes. Reject blue background samples only in these inspected instrument boxes, retaining geometry as inferred fill.

lowerMarginReason: Inherited coarse rock/plinth cut includes thin plinth strips. Reject an extra sampling band around the lower silhouette; retain its geometry and mark unavailable color as appearance fill. No erosion of the upper thin instrument.
limitations: Conservative human-reviewed texture masks, not pixel-accurate ground truth. Original inward-biased upper contours retained. Lower rim and uncertain gaps may use low-frequency appearance fill, visibly marked in source maps.
